scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix services/auth install && npm --prefix services/project install && npm --prefix services/file install && npm --prefix services/ai install && npm --prefix services/terminal install && npm --prefix services/payment install
scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,PROJ,FILE,AI,TERM,PAY" -c "cyan,blue,green,magenta,yellow,red,white" "npm --prefix gateway start" "npm --prefix services/auth start" "npm --prefix services/project start" "npm --prefix services/file start" "npm --prefix services/ai start" "npm --prefix services/terminal start" "npm --prefix services/payment start"
